tasks_snapshot.title: 音源試作08 SNES S-DSP：資料/ライセンスと対象範囲を確定し、レジスタ/状態・8声/BRR・envelope/noise/echo等をForthで検証/測定、SPC700 CPUとは分けて本体移行の採否と未実装を記録
SNES01 仕様・Forth実装と独立検証：対象モデル/変種と宣言範囲を資料で確定、状態/時刻境界とPCMを別実装・手計算で照合しClaudeレビューと採否論点を記録
SNES nativeフレームkernel：実測不足を受けAUDIO内の同期・借用buffer処理を設計/実装し、Forth/独立Pythonとの全PCM・state・ARAM一致、境界/機能除外/画像互換とClaudeレビューを確認
SNES Windows受け入れ：通常/機能除外構成の独立PCM/状態照合、サイズと速度・採否、Windows実装置での生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/版/装置を記録
SNES Linux受け入れ：通常/機能除外構成の独立PCM/状態照合、サイズと速度・採否、PulseAudio/ALSAでの生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/版/装置とWSL/実機の別を記録
SNES Mac受け入れ：Mac実機の通常/機能除外構成・独立PCM/状態照合・サイズと速度、生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/CPU/版/装置を記録。完了まで機種の親を未完了に維持

status: Native functionality and Windows/WSL timing verified; Windows1175 and Linux1176 accepted within declared route/WSL limits. Mac1177 and parent1173 remain incomplete.

windows/model-forth.scope: Independent integer S-DSP sample-boundary oracle; all generated audio stays in RAM.

windows/model-native.scope: Independent integer S-DSP sample-boundary oracle; all generated audio stays in RAM.

windows/stream-forth.scope: Owned stereo callback fixtures: nonzero model output stays in memory, no native audio.

windows/stream-native.scope: Owned stereo callback fixtures: nonzero model output stays in memory, no native audio.

windows/extra-native.scope: Native S-DSP batches, backend changes, bounded interruption and saved execution tokens. No audio/timing.

windows/native-untimed.scope: Declared S-DSP core only, not SPC700/ROM/device. Six16384frame stereo loads. Default no NTIME/CPUTIME calls. --measure7 fresh processes per load with rotated order; warmup/reset/fullARAM reset/A5/pre-state outside timing. Every fullPCM/266semantic state/queue2/fullARAM checked outside timing. Dense8kHz2events includes reg/ownedRAM byte enqueue and compaction checks; no pending entries moved. Wall primary may jump, CPUTIME reference may be quantized and2 calls included in wall. Linux is WSL2.

Wall primary may jump, CPUTIME reference may be quantized and2 calls included in wall. Linux is WSL2.

 r['binaries_sha256']={name:hashlib.sha256((root/b).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,b in [('new',new),('legacy',old),('audio_excluded',off)]}
 results[os]=r
(folder/'features-and-legacy-images.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

//! Types shared by the core: built-in word ids, dictionary entries, operations, and errors.

const std = @import("std");
const memory_map = @import("memory_map.zig");
const Cell = memory_map.Cell;
const Double = memory_map.Double;
const Float = memory_map.Float;
const UCell = memory_map.UCell;
const UDouble = memory_map.UDouble;
const forth_wordlist = memory_map.forth_wordlist;
const max_name = memory_map.max_name;

const build_options = @import("build_options");

/// False in a build with -Dfloat=false, which leaves out the floating-point words.
pub const float_enabled = build_options.float;
/// False with -Dfiles=false, which leaves out the words that open, read, write, or include
/// files (also the $...SLURP words, which read a file or a file id).
pub const files_enabled = build_options.files;
/// False with -Dhelp=false, which leaves out HELP, LICENSE, and their texts.
pub const help_enabled = build_options.help;
/// False with -Dtools=false, which leaves out SEE, LOCATE, and WHERE.
pub const tools_enabled = build_options.tools;
/// False with -Ddebug=false, which leaves out the debugging features: the backtrace after
/// an error (and the lines of the code, which it shows), the step limit (--max-steps),
/// the trace (--trace), and the words of words_debug.zig.
pub const debug_enabled = build_options.debug;
/// False with -Dimage=false, which leaves out SAVE, LOAD-DICTIONARY, and SAVESYS.
pub const image_enabled = build_options.image;
/// False with -Dgraphics=false, which leaves out REQUIRE-GRAPHICS and the GFX- words.
pub const graphics_enabled = build_options.graphics;
/// False with -Daudio=false, which leaves out REQUIRE-AUDIO and the SND- words.
pub const audio_enabled = build_options.audio;
/// Public extension words only; shared host runtime services remain independent.
pub const extension_enabled = build_options.extension;

/// The built-in words of the floating-point word set: those of words_float.zig and the
/// float fields, sizes, and defining words of the other files.
pub fn isFloatBuiltin(builtin: Builtin) bool {
    return float_builtins[@backingInt(builtin)];
}

/// A built-in word of a group this build leaves out. Such a word is not in the dictionary
/// and its code is not compiled in.
pub fn isExcludedBuiltin(builtin: Builtin) bool {
    return excluded_builtins[@backingInt(builtin)];
}

const builtin_count = @typeInfo(Builtin).@"enum".field_names.len;

fn builtinSet(comptime lists: []const []const Builtin) [builtin_count]bool {
    var table: [builtin_count]bool = @splat(false);
    for (lists) |list| {
        for (list) |word| table[@backingInt(word)] = true;
    }
    return table;
}

const float_builtins = builtinSet(&.{ &@import("words_float.zig").words, &@import("words_stack_display.zig").float_words, &@import("words_return_extensions.zig").float_words, &.{ .field_float, .field_sfloat, .field_dfloat, .float_percent, .sfloat_percent, .dfloat_percent, .define_fvariable, .define_fconstant, .define_fvalue, .fliteral } });
const file_builtins = builtinSet(&.{ &@import("words_files.zig").words, &@import("blocks.zig").words, &.{ .execute_parsing_file, .string_slurp, .string_plus_slurp, .string_slurp_file, .string_plus_slurp_file, .string_slurp_line, .string_array_slurp, .string_array_slurp_file } });
const help_builtins = builtinSet(&.{&.{ .help, .license }});
const tool_builtins = builtinSet(&.{ &.{ .see, .locate, .where }, &@import("source_navigation.zig").tool_words, &@import("source_search.zig").words, &@import("source_listing.zig").words, &@import("source_editor.zig").words, &@import("source_diagnostics.zig").trace_words, &.{.fancy_after_l} });
const image_builtins = builtinSet(&.{&.{ .load, .save, .savesys, .app_entry_set, .app_entry_get, .app_entry_off }});
const graphics_builtins = builtinSet(&.{&@import("words_graphics.zig").words});
const audio_builtins = builtinSet(&.{&@import("words_audio.zig").words});
const extension_builtins = builtinSet(&.{&@import("words_extension.zig").words});
const debug_builtins = builtinSet(&.{ &@import("words_debug.zig").words, &.{ .exec_limited, .assert_close, .assert_level, .assert_zero, .assert_one, .assert_two, .assert_three }, &@import("source_diagnostics.zig").trace_words });

const excluded_builtins = blk: {
    @setEvalBranchQuota(builtin_count * 16);
    var table: [builtin_count]bool = undefined;
    for (&table, 0..) |*excluded, index| {
        excluded.* = (!float_enabled and float_builtins[index]) or (!files_enabled and file_builtins[index]) or
            (!help_enabled and help_builtins[index]) or (!tools_enabled and tool_builtins[index]) or
            (!image_enabled and image_builtins[index]) or (!graphics_enabled and graphics_builtins[index]) or
            (!audio_enabled and audio_builtins[index]) or (!extension_enabled and extension_builtins[index]) or
            (!debug_enabled and debug_builtins[index]);
    }
    break :blk table;
};

/// Local operations other than `local_frame` encode the frame offset in the low 32 bits
/// of the value and the `LocalKind` above them; `local_frame` holds the word id.
// Execution-only specializations are normalized when saving an image. Everything
// from dup onward is a primitive operation named after its Builtin; value remains
// the original word id. Keep the serialized tags (call through call_builtin) stable.
pub const OpKind = enum {
    call,
    compile_call,
    builtin,
    literal,
    float_literal,
    execution_token,
    store_value,
    branch,
    branch_zero,
    do_loop,

    leave,

    string_literal,

    abort_string,
    does,

    local_frame,
    local_store,

    local_address,
    local_execute,
    add_value,
    positive_do,
    unsigned_positive_do,
    negative_do,
    unsigned_negative_do,
    inclusive_negative_do,
    unsigned_inclusive_negative_do,
    for_loop,
    memory_up_do,
    memory_down_do,
    negative_loop,
    next_loop,
    call_builtin,
    call_colon,
    dup,
    drop,
    swap,
    over,
    rot,
    nip,
    tuck,
    two_dup,
    two_drop,
    add,
    sub,
    mul,
    equal,
    not_equal,
    less,
    greater,
    zero_equal,
    zero_less,
    bit_and,
    bit_or,
    bit_xor,
    bit_complement,
    negate,
    one_plus,
    one_minus,
    to_r,

    r_fetch,

    store,
    cfetch,
    cstore,
    add_store,
    index,
    index_2,
    cells,
    cell_plus,
    two_star,
    two_slash,
    lshift,
    rshift,
    f_add,
    f_sub,
    f_mul,
    f_div,
    f_dup,
    f_drop,
    f_swap,
    f_over,
    execute,
};

pub fn isPrimitiveOp(kind: OpKind) bool {
    return @backingInt(kind) >= @backingInt(OpKind.dup);
}

pub fn primitiveBuiltin(comptime kind: OpKind) Builtin {
    if (!isPrimitiveOp(kind)) @compileError("not a primitive operation");
    return @field(Builtin, @tagName(kind));
}

pub fn builtinOpKind(builtin: Builtin) OpKind {
    return switch (builtin) {
        inline .dup, .drop, .swap, .over, .rot, .nip, .tuck, .two_dup, .two_drop, .add, .sub, .mul, .equal, .not_equal, .less, .greater, .zero_equal, .zero_less, .bit_and, .bit_or, .bit_xor, .bit_complement, .negate, .one_plus, .one_minus, .to_r, .from_r, .r_fetch, .fetch, .store, .cfetch, .cstore, .add_store, .index, .index_2, .cells, .cell_plus, .two_star, .two_slash, .lshift, .rshift, .f_add, .f_sub, .f_mul, .f_div, .f_dup, .f_drop, .f_swap, .f_over, .execute => |hot| @field(OpKind, @tagName(hot)),
        else => .call_builtin,
    };
}

comptime {
    if (@sizeOf(OpKind) != 1) @compileError("operation tags must keep their image layout");
}

    name_len: u8 = 0,

    variable: bool = false,
    offset: u16 = 0,
};

pub const Op = struct { kind: OpKind, value: Cell = 0 };

pub const ControlKind = enum { if_branch, else_branch, begin_loop, while_branch, do_loop, case_start, of_branch, endof_branch };

/// `locals` is the number of local names visible where the structure starts; a DO loop
/// also keeps the fewest visible at any of its LEAVEs.
pub const Control = struct { kind: ControlKind, address: u16, locals: u16 = 0, leave_locals: u16 = std.math.maxInt(u16) };

pub const Loop = struct { index: Cell, limit: Cell, exit_pc: u16, leave_keeps_frame: bool = false, stride: UCell = 1, mode: enum { normal, countdown, memory_up, memory_down } = .normal };

pub const Pending = enum { none, colon_name, variable_name, constant_name, array_name, forget_name, tick_name, value_name, watched_value_name, watched_variable_name, to_name, char_name, postpone_name, fconstant_name, fvalue_name, fvariable_name, two_constant_name, two_value_name, two_variable_name, buffer_name, plus_to_name, action_of_name, aconstant_name, avariable_name, string_value_name, replacer_name };

pub const StringWord = enum { s_quote, s_escape_quote, print_escape, print_paren, c_quote, abort_quote };

pub const ParsedNumber = struct { value: Double, double: bool };

pub const RuntimeError = error{
    StackUnderflow,
    ReturnStackUnderflow,
    StackOverflow,
    ReturnStackOverflow,
    FloatStackUnderflow,
    FloatStackOverflow,
    DictionaryFull,
    CodeFull,
    NameTooLong,
    InvalidDefinition,
    CommentUnclosed,
    ControlMismatch,
    ControlStackOverflow,
    CompileOnly,
    UnknownWord,
    InvalidNumber,
    DivisionByZero,
    ResultOutOfRange,
    /// QUIT: back to the terminal with the data stacks kept; CATCH does not catch it.
    Quit,
    LoopMismatch,
    InvalidBase,
    InvalidExecutionToken,
    InvalidAddress,
    InvalidBlockNumber,
    PicturedNumericOverflow,
    MemoryExhausted,
    InputUnavailable,
    FileUnavailable,
    InvalidImage,
    Aborted,
    HostUnavailable,
    HostFailed,
    StringTooLong,
    /// A non-zero code passed to THROW; the code is kept in `State.throw_code`.
    Thrown,
    IncludeNesting,
    TooManySourceFiles,
    SearchOrderOverflow,
    SearchOrderUnderflow,
    InvalidWordlist,
    /// REQUIRE-GRAPHICS in a build without graphics (-Dgraphics=false).
    GraphicsUnavailable,
    /// A GFX- word that needs an image before GFX-INIT has made one.
    NoCanvas,
    /// Ctrl+C read by INKEY or MOUSE.
    UserInterrupt,
    /// A font LOAD-FONT cannot read, or a name the system has no font of.
    FontUnavailable,
    /// A Tcl script that failed (TCL, TCL-EVAL, DISPLAY-TK).
    TclFailed,
    /// A PLAY string that is not MSX BASIC's music macro language, or a number in it
    /// out of its range.
    InvalidMml,
    /// REQUIRE-AUDIO in a build without sound (-Daudio=false).
    AudioUnavailable,
    /// A file LOAD-SAMPLE cannot read: not a WAV file of 8- or 16-bit PCM.
    SampleInvalid,
    /// A file LOAD-MOD cannot read: not a ProTracker module of four channels.
    ModInvalid,
    /// A handle that names no image of the pool: never made, freed, or from before a restore.
    InvalidImageHandle,
    /// A file LOAD-IMAGE cannot read: not a PNG, BMP, or PPM/PGM file it knows, or damaged.
    ImageInvalid,
    /// Compiled code ran more operations than --max-steps allows; CATCH does not catch it.
    StepLimit,
    WarningError,
};

pub fn floatBits(value: Float) Cell {
    return @bitCast(value);
}

pub fn bitsFloat(value: Cell) Float {
    return @bitCast(value);
}

pub const DoubleCells = struct { low: Cell, high: Cell };

pub fn doubleCells(value: Double) DoubleCells {
    const bits: UDouble = @bitCast(value);
    return .{ .low = @bitCast(@as(UCell, @truncate(bits))), .high = @bitCast(@as(UCell, @truncate(bits >> 64))) };
}

pub fn cellsDouble(low: Cell, high: Cell) Double {
    const bits = (@as(UDouble, @as(UCell, @bitCast(high))) << 64) | @as(UCell, @bitCast(low));
    return @bitCast(bits);
}

/// Built-in VALUEs backed by fixed system cells; also checked by image validation.
pub fn builtinValueAddress(word: Builtin) ?Cell {
    return switch (word) {
        .csv_quote => memory_map.csv_quote_address,
        .csv_separator => memory_map.csv_separator_address,
        .f_s_precision => memory_map.f_s_precision_address,
        .before_locate => memory_map.before_locate_address,
        .after_locate => memory_map.after_locate_address,
        else => null,
    };
}

    // Dynamic strings
    .{ .name = "$!", .stack = "( addr u $var -- )", .text = "Store a string in a string variable." },

    .{ .name = "NEW-IMAGE", .stack = "( w h -- img )", .text = "Make a black image besides the screen, each side 1 to 16384; at most 256 images and 1 GiB in all, else OUT OF MEMORY. Images are not saved (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "FREE-IMAGE", .stack = "( img -- )", .text = "Free an image; its handle becomes invalid (-278), and drawing goes back to the screen when it was drawn on (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "IMAGE-SIZE", .stack = "( img -- w h )", .text = "The width and height of an image, or of the screen (0 0 before GFX-INIT) (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "DRAW-TO", .stack = "( img -- )", .text = "Make the drawing words, GFX-WIDTH, GFX-HEIGHT, and the SAVE- words use an image; SCREEN for the screen (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "DRAWING", .stack = "( -- img )", .text = "The handle of the image drawn on (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "TRANSPARENT", .stack = "( rgb|-1 -- )", .text = "The color COPY-RECT and PUT-IMAGE leave out, or -1 for none (the start) (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "IMAGE-FLIP", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "How COPY-RECT and PUT-IMAGE flip: 0 not, 1 left and right, 2 top and bottom, 3 both (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "COPY-RECT", .stack = "( src sx sy w h dx dy -- )", .text = "Copy the w by h rectangle at sx sy of image src to dx dy of the image drawn on, with TRANSPARENT, IMAGE-FLIP, IMAGE-MODE, and IMAGE-SCALE; parts outside are left out (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "IMAGE-MODE", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "How COPY-RECT and PUT-IMAGE put the pixels: 0 over those there (the start), 1 XOR, 2 added (each color at most 255), 3 mixed by IMAGE-ALPHA (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "IMAGE-ALPHA", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "How much of the copy IMAGE-MODE 3 shows, 0 (none) to 255 (all); 128 at the start (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "IMAGE-SCALE", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "COPY-RECT and PUT-IMAGE draw each pixel n by n, 1 (the start) to 16 (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "PUT-IMAGE", .stack = "( src x y -- )", .text = "Copy the whole image src to x y of the image drawn on, as COPY-RECT does (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "LOAD-IMAGE", .stack = "( c-addr u -- img )", .text = "Read a PNG, BMP, or PPM/PGM file into a new image; pixels more than half transparent get the TRANSPARENT color, black when none. IMAGE FORMAT ERROR (-279) for a file it cannot read (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-IMAGE-LOAD", .stack = "( c-addr u key -- img ior )", .text = "Primitive for LOAD-IMAGE: key is the color of the transparent pixels, negative for black; ior of opening or reading the file, img 0 then (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-IMAGE-NEW", .stack = "( w h -- img )", .text = "Primitive for NEW-IMAGE (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-IMAGE-FREE", .stack = "( img -- )", .text = "Primitive for FREE-IMAGE (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-IMAGE-SIZE", .stack = "( img -- w h )", .text = "Primitive for IMAGE-SIZE (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-TARGET", .stack = "( img -- )", .text = "Primitive for DRAW-TO (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-TARGET@", .stack = "( -- img )", .text = "Primitive for DRAWING (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-COPY", .stack = "( src sx sy w h dx dy key flip mode alpha scale -- )", .text = "Copy a rectangle to the image drawn on; key is the transparent color or negative, flip 0 to 3, mode 0 to 3, alpha 0 to 255, scale 1 to 16. Flipping or scaling within one image onto an overlapping place is NUMBER ERROR (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-COLOR-MODE", .stack = "( n flag -- )", .text = "Show the image with 0 (full color), 2, 16, or 256 colors, dithered when flag is true (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "DISPLAY-COLORS", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "Make SHOW use full color (0) or 2, 16, or 256 colors; the image keeps its colors (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "DITHER", .stack = "( flag -- )", .text = "Make SHOW mix the colors of fewer colors with a 4 by 4 Bayer matrix (true) or take the nearest (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-GLYPH-LOAD", .stack = "( code -- advance | -1 )", .text = "Load the glyph of a code point in TEXT's current font; -1 when the font has none (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-GLYPH-BOX", .stack = "( -- left width height )", .text = "The box of the loaded glyph, from the pen and the top of the line (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-GLYPH-ALPHA", .stack = "( x y -- a )", .text = "The coverage, 0 to 255, of the loaded glyph at x y of its box (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-FONT-HEIGHT", .stack = "( -- h )", .text = "The height of a line of TEXT's current font (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-FONT-BUILTIN", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Use the built-in ASCII font for TEXT (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-FONT-LOAD", .stack = "( c-addr u -- ior )", .text = "Read a BDF font file for TEXT; ior 0, the file's error, or -272 (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-FONT-SYSTEM", .stack = "( c-addr u height -- ior )", .text = "Use the system's font of that name, height pixels a line, for TEXT; ior 0 or -272 (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "TEXT", .stack = "( c-addr u x y -- )", .text = "Draw the UTF-8 string with the top left of its line at x y, in the current font and color (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "TEXT-HEIGHT", .stack = "( -- h )", .text = "The height of a line of TEXT, at the current scale (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "BUILTIN-FONT", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Draw TEXT with the built-in ASCII font, 4 by 8 pixels (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "LOAD-FONT", .stack = "( c-addr u -- )", .text = "Read the named BDF font file and draw TEXT with it; THROW on failure (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "SYSTEM-FONT", .stack = "( c-addr u height -- )", .text = "Draw TEXT with the system's font of that name, height pixels a line, smoothed (Windows, macOS, and Linux, where the name may be a font file's path; FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "TEXT-SCALE", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "Draw each pixel of TEXT's font as n by n pixels, 1 to 256; 1 at first (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "TEXT-WIDTH", .stack = "( c-addr u -- w )", .text = "How many pixels wide TEXT draws the string (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "INKEY", .stack = "( -- key | -1 )", .text = "The next key pressed, without waiting; -1 when none. Keys that are not characters give K-UP and so on (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "KEY-HELD?", .stack = "( key -- flag )", .text = "Whether the key (a character of one byte, or K-UP and so on) is held down now; the Windows console and the windows tell when a key is released, while a key from a terminal on Linux or macOS counts as held for 0.6 s after it was pressed (0.12 s once it is repeating), or until another cursor key is pressed if it is a cursor key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "WINDOW-SIZE", .stack = "( w h -- )", .text = "Show the image in a window w by h pixels large from the next SHOW, keeping its proportions with black around it; 0 0 for the image's own size (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MOUSE", .stack = "( -- x y buttons )", .text = "The pixel of the image under the mouse, -1 -1 when not known, and the buttons held: 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MOUSE-ON", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Have the terminal report the mouse, for MOUSE (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MOUSE-OFF", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Stop the terminal's mouse reports (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MOUSE-EVENT", .stack = "( -- x y button kind true | false )", .text = "The oldest mouse event not yet read, without waiting: kind 1 pressed, 2 released (button 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle), 3 the wheel (button 1 up, -1 down); 64 are kept, the oldest dropped (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "GFX-MOUSE-EVENT", .stack = "( -- x y button kind true | false )", .text = "Primitive for MOUSE-EVENT (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "FRAME", .stack = "( ms -- )", .text = "Wait until ms milliseconds have passed since the last FRAME, then SHOW, for animation at a steady pace (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-UP", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Up arrow key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-DOWN", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Down arrow key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-LEFT", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Left arrow key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-RIGHT", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Right arrow key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-HOME", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Home key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-END", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the End key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-PRIOR", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Page Up key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-NEXT", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Page Down key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-INSERT", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Insert key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-DELETE", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the Delete key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F1", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F1 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F2", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F2 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F3", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F3 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F4", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F4 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F5", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F5 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F6", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F6 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F7", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F7 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F8", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F8 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F9", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F9 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F10", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F10 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F11", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F11 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "K-F12", .stack = "( -- key )", .text = "The code INKEY gives for the F12 key (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    // The floating-point part of the graphics library (src/graphics/graphics_float.fs).
    .{ .name = "X-RANGE", .stack = "( F: lo hi -- )", .text = "Make the image show x from lo at the left edge to hi at the right one; -1 to 1 at first (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "Y-RANGE", .stack = "( F: lo hi -- )", .text = "Make the image show y from lo at the bottom edge to hi at the top one; -1 to 1 at first (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MPSET", .stack = "( F: x y -- )", .text = "Set the pixel at the mathematical coordinates x y to the current color (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "MLINE", .stack = "( F: x1 y1 x2 y2 -- )", .text = "Draw a line between two points in mathematical coordinates (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "AXES", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Draw the axes x = 0 and y = 0 that are in the range, with the current color (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    .{ .name = "PLOT", .stack = "( xt -- )", .text = "Draw the graph of xt ( F: x -- y ) across the image, joining the columns with lines; NaN leaves a gap (FORTH/Sigma graphics)." },
    // Audio (FORTH/Sigma): the SND- words and the audio library are in the AUDIO vocabulary.
    .{ .name = "REQUIRE-EXTENSION", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Load the independent EXTENSION vocabulary once; select it with ALSO EXTENSION (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "HOST-OS", .stack = "( -- c-addr u )", .text = "Return borrowed lowercase target OS family: windows, linux (including WSL/Android), macos, or unknown. Valid until the next HOST-OS or image restore; do not modify it. Copy it to retain it. Values may grow; treat unfamiliar values as unknown (FORTH/Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "EKEY-WAIT", .stack = "( ms -- event flag ior )", .text = "Wait for a complete standard event with one monotonic deadline; zero polls, negative waits indefinitely. Timeout returns 0 0 0, EOF K-EOF true 0. Partial input survives timeout and interruption. Selected files decode UTF-8 with literal ESC and byte 3; host-owned partial bytes remain readable after the scope exits. A missing file-wait callback throws -21." },
    .{ .name = "EKEY-MOUSE", .stack = "( -- column row buttons wheel )", .text = "Return metadata of the last consumed K-MOUSE; peeking does not update it. Coordinates start at zero; buttons use left=1 right=2 middle=4, wheel up=1 down=-1." },
    .{ .name = "WAIT-FILES", .stack = "( addr n ms -- index ior )", .text = "Wait for the first readable file ID in a 1..64-cell array; EOF and I/O errors are ready. Validate all IDs first. Zero polls, negative waits indefinitely; timeout returns -1 0. Ctrl+C throws -28. Requires optional host file I/O support." },
    .{ .name = "READ-AVAILABLE", .stack = "( c-addr u fid -- u2 eof? ior )", .text = "Read currently available bytes without waiting for a producer; distinguish temporary emptiness from observed EOF. Return the transferred count even with an I/O error. An empty buffer validates without consuming input. Host partial bytes are shared with ordinary file words." },
    .{ .name = "WRITE-AVAILABLE", .stack = "( c-addr u fid -- u2 ior )", .text = "Accept as many bytes as can be queued without waiting for a consumer. The host copies accepted bytes before returning; the count does not guarantee delivery. Later pipe errors remain sticky until close. FLUSH-FILE and close wait for delivery." },
    .{ .name = "WAIT-WRITABLE", .stack = "( addr n ms -- index ior )", .text = "Wait for the first file ID that can accept output or report an I/O error; validate all 1..64 IDs first. Zero polls, negative waits indefinitely; timeout returns -1 0. Ctrl+C throws -28. Native resource ownership stays at the host." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-NEW", .stack = "( -- proc ior )", .text = "Create an owned process configuration; the host supports 64 public records." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-ARG", .stack = "( addr len proc -- ior )", .text = "Copy an argument before startup; the first is argv[0]. No implicit shell." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-CWD", .stack = "( addr len proc -- ior )", .text = "Copy child working directory before startup; empty inherits the startup-time parent directory." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-ENV", .stack = "( addr len proc -- ior )", .text = "Apply an environment edit: NAME=VALUE sets, NAME removes, NAME= sets empty." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-IO", .stack = "( mode which proc -- ior )", .text = "Configure stdin/stdout/stderr (which=0/1/2): mode=0 pipe, 1 inherit, 2 null, 3 stderr merge. Defaults to three pipes." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-START", .stack = "( proc -- ior )", .text = "Start the configured executable with copied argv, environment and directory." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-STDIN", .stack = "( proc -- fid ior )", .text = "Return the writable child input FILE ID; zero if not piped." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-STDOUT", .stack = "( proc -- fid ior )", .text = "Return the readable child output FILE ID; zero if not piped." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-STDERR", .stack = "( proc -- fid ior )", .text = "Return the readable child error FILE ID; zero if not piped or merged." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-STATUS", .stack = "( proc -- state code ior )", .text = "Observe retained status: 0 configuring, 1 running, 2 exited, 3 POSIX signal. Windows retains unsigned 32-bit exit codes." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-WAIT", .stack = "( proc ms -- state code ior )", .text = "Wait with one monotonic deadline: zero polls, negative waits indefinitely. Timeout retains state 1; Ctrl+C throws -28 without killing the child." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-TERM", .stack = "( proc -- ior )", .text = "Request group termination without waiting: SIGTERM on POSIX, terminate Job with exit 143 on Windows." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-KILL", .stack = "( proc -- ior )", .text = "Request group termination without waiting: SIGKILL on POSIX, terminate Job with exit 137 on Windows." },
    .{ .name = "PROC-FREE", .stack = "( proc -- ior )", .text = "Release configuring or terminal records, discard remaining pipe data and reap the root child. Running returns EBUSY; failed cleanup retains ownership for retry." },
    .{ .name = "X-GRAPHEME", .stack = "( c-addr u -- u1 )", .text = "Byte length of the first default extended grapheme cluster (Unicode 18.0.0, UAX #29 rev 49); empty gives zero. Checks strict UTF-8 through one lookahead scalar only: invalid input there throws -24, invalid memory -9, preserving arguments. Later bytes are not decoded. Treats the supplied slice as independent text. Returns bytes, not display width; width tables remain 15.1.0." },
    .{ .name = "X-GRAPHEME-LAST", .stack = "( c-addr u -- u1 )", .text = "Byte length of the last default extended grapheme cluster (Unicode 18.0.0, UAX #29 rev 49); pass the original start and whole length. Empty gives zero. Scans the whole slice, strict UTF-8 errors throw -24, memory errors -9, preserving arguments. Each call is linear in input length for the fixed property table; repeated backward deletion can be quadratic. Returns bytes, not columns." },
    .{ .name = "COMPACT-FILENAME", .stack = "( c-addr u -- c-addr u2 )", .text = "Compact a byte path in place like Gforth 1.0.2, retaining its address. Only slash separates components; terminal dot/dot-dot are retained. Does not access the filesystem or resolve links. Invalid memory/negative length throws -9, temporary allocation failure -257, preserving arguments and source. No fixed 1024-byte limit; files support is not required." },
    .{ .name = "FILE>REALPATH", .stack = "( name u buffer capacity -- needed ior )", .text = "Resolve an existing path including links; copy exactly needed bytes without NUL. Short capacity (zero queries size) returns needed and ERANGE without changing the buffer; other errors return 0 and ior. Input/output may overlap. Windows returns extended UTF-8 paths with backslashes; input limit is 4095 bytes. No tilde or FPATH expansion. Invalid ranges throw -9; missing host/files capability -21. Arguments survive THROW." },
    .{ .name = "FILE-METADATA", .stack = "( name u -- ud-size mtime-sec mtime-nsec ior )", .text = "Follow links and query one regular file's byte size (double cell), signed Unix UTC seconds and nanoseconds 0..999999999. Actual precision depends on the filesystem. Errors return four zero cells and ior. Empty/NUL names and nonregular files return EINVAL. No change-detection or later-operation snapshot guarantee. Missing host/files throws -21; invalid memory/negative length -9." },
    .{ .name = "EXEC-LIMITED", .stack = "( i*x xt u -- j*x ior )", .text = "Debug-only bounded execution. Zero u means unlimited with interrupt checks. Returns 0 normally or -280 when this entry exhausts its budget, restoring entry stack depths but not values or side effects. All enclosing budgets are charged; outer exhaustion unwinds to its owner. CLI step exhaustion, ordinary THROW and -28 propagate. At most 16 entries. Host interrupt support required (-21). Native/OS calls stop only at cooperative checkpoints. No continuation. Passing returned -280 to THROW retains fatal StepLimit behavior." },
    .{ .name = "SYNC-FILE", .stack = "( fileid -- ior )", .text = "Synchronize a writable regular file's C stream and request fsync or FlushFileBuffers. Retains handle, logical position, pending input and semantic EOF on success. Standard streams and nonregular files return EINVAL, invalid/closed IDs EBADF, read-only EACCES. OS failure retains ownership. May block without cancellation. No rename/parent-directory or power-loss durability guarantee; macOS uses fsync, not F_FULLFSYNC. FLUSH-FILE is unchanged." },
    .{ .name = "K-MOUSE", .stack = "( -- event )", .text = "Standard terminal mouse event; use EKEY-MOUSE after consuming it." },
    .{ .name = "K-PASTE-BEGIN", .stack = "( -- event )", .text = "Start of bracketed paste; content is text including ESC and byte 3." },
    .{ .name = "K-PASTE-END", .stack = "( -- event )", .text = "End of bracketed paste." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-MODE!", .stack = "( mask -- ior )", .text = "Replace accepted terminal requests (bits 1/2/4/8). 0 succeeds, -24 invalid mask, -21 unavailable, -265 host failure. Windows ignores paste. Raw-only mouse/paste are delayed; existing MOUSE-ON shares the request (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-MODE@", .stack = "( -- mask )", .text = "Return accepted terminal requests, excluding unsupported/uncertain bits, independent of temporary suspension and raw mode. This records accepted requests, not an acknowledgment from the terminal (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "COLS", .stack = "( -- u )", .text = "Return FORM column count with the same output target, capture and fallback rules (extension vocabulary)." },
    .{ .name = "ROWS", .stack = "( -- u )", .text = "Return FORM row count with the same output target, capture and fallback rules (extension vocabulary)." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-ALT-SCREEN", .stack = "( -- mask )", .text = "Push 1, the alternate screen request bit (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-PASTE", .stack = "( -- mask )", .text = "Push 2, the raw bracketed paste request bit. Windows ignores it. POSIX markers are not decoded by this version; event decoding is planned separately (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-HIDE-CURSOR", .stack = "( -- mask )", .text = "Push 4, the hidden cursor request bit (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "TERM-MOUSE", .stack = "( -- mask )", .text = "Push 8, the raw mouse reporting request bit, shared with MOUSE-ON/OFF (Sigma extension)." },
    .{ .name = "REQUIRE-AUDIO", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Load the audio words into the AUDIO vocabulary, the first time only (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-PLAY", .stack = "( c-addr1 u1 c-addr2 u2 c-addr3 u3 -- )", .text = "Put the MML of the three voices of one PLAY; an empty string for a voice that has no notes (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-SOUND", .stack = "( reg value -- )", .text = "Host primitive for SOUND (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-BEEP", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Host primitive for BEEP (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-PLAYING", .stack = "( n -- flag )", .text = "Host primitive for PLAY? (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-DEVICE", .stack = "( -- flag )", .text = "Host primitive for AUDIO? (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "PLAY", .stack = "( c-addr u -- )", .text = "Play MSX BASIC's MML on voice A, returning once the notes fit in the queue; an invalid string throws -274 (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "PLAY2", .stack = "( c-addr1 u1 c-addr2 u2 -- )", .text = "Play MML on voices A and B, starting together (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "PLAY3", .stack = "( c-addr1 u1 c-addr2 u2 c-addr3 u3 -- )", .text = "Play MML on voices A, B, and C, starting together (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "PLAY?", .stack = "( n -- flag )", .text = "Whether voice n (1 to 8), or any voice for 0, still has notes to play, as MSX BASIC's PLAY(n) (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "SOUND", .stack = "( reg value -- )", .text = "Write a value 0 to 255 to the PSG's register 0 to 13, as MSX BASIC's SOUND (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "BEEP", .stack = "( -- )", .text = "Stop the music, set the PSG and the PLAY settings as at start, and beep (FORTH/Sigma audio)." },
    .{ .name = "AUDIO?", .stack = "( -- flag )", .text = "Report whether an available audio engine reaches a physical device; without a device it runs silently. A host without an audio engine callback throws HostUnavailable instead of returning false." },
    .{ .name = "SND-PLAYS", .stack = "( c-addr1 u1 ... c-addrn un n -- )", .text = "Host primitive for PLAYS (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-CHIP", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "Host primitive for MSX-SOUND (0), ST-SOUND (1), NES-SOUND (2), C64-SOUND (3), SCC-SOUND (4), and AMIGA-SOUND (5) (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-INSTRUMENT", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "Host primitive for INSTRUMENT (FORTH/Sigma)." },
    .{ .name = "SND-WAVE", .stack = "( n -- )", .text = "Host primitive for SQUARE (0), PULSE (1), TRIANGLE (2), SAW (3), and NOISE (4) (FORTH/Sigma)." },

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent integer S-DSP sample-boundary oracle; all generated audio stays in RAM."""
import argparse,hashlib,heapq,json,platform,re,struct,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
if not __debug__:raise SystemExit("Verification requires assertions; do not use -O.")
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA=json.loads((ROOT/'scripts/snes-gauss-data.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
GAUSS=DATA['values']
RATES=[0,2048,1536,1280,1024,768,640,512,384,320,256,192,160,128,96,80,64,48,40,32,24,20,16,12,10,8,6,5,4,3,2,1]
FIELDS=['on','pos','nib','header','p1','p2','phase','env','mode','delay']
GLOBALS=['CYCLE','DIV','FRAME','PENDING','NOISE','EOFF','ELEN','EHI','LEFT','RIGHT']
DUMP=': SNAP 128 0 DO I SD-R@ . LOOP 112 0 DO SD-VOICES I CELLS + @ . LOOP '+' '.join('SD-'+v+' @ .' for v in GLOBALS)+' 16 0 DO SD-EHIST I CELLS + @ . LOOP SD-EVENT-COUNT @ . SD-EVENT-INDEX @ . ;\n'
def signed(n,bits):return (n+(1<<(bits-1)))%(1<<bits)-(1<<(bits-1))
def clamp(n):return min(32767,max(-32768,n))
def brr(nibble,header,old,older):
    n=signed(nibble,4);shift=header>>4
    val=n*2**shift//2 if shift<=12 else -2048 if n<0 else 0
    # Mathematically equivalent rational predictors, distinct from Forth shift decomposition.
    p,q=[(0,0),(old*15//16,0),(old*61//32,older*-15//16),(old*115//64,older*-13//16)][header//4%4]
    return signed(clamp(val+p+q),15)

class Model:
